_comment: The usable CPUs a binding gives a thread rule (CON304). Oxidation review D16: the smaller of the affinity mask and the cgroup v2 cpu.max quota, in whole CPUs rounded down, at least 1. Owner decision 2026-11-25: every cpu.max from the process's own cgroup up to the root counts, and the smallest quota on that path wins, since the kernel enforces each of them.
events: affinity is the count of CPUs in the process's affinity mask. cpu_max lists the text of each cpu.max from the process's own cgroup up to the root, own first, with null where the file is missing; an empty list is a process without a cgroup v2 path. Each text is `<quota> <period>` in microseconds, and a quota of max sets no limit. usable is max(1, floor(min(affinity, the smallest quota/period on the path)))

cases.name: a quota of 1.5 CPUs rounds down
a quota under one CPU still gives one
a quota above the affinity count leaves the affinity
a missing file sets no limit
no cgroup path leaves the affinity
a limited parent with an unlimited child
a child tighter than its parent
a parent tighter than its child
the period is the cgroup's own
the smallest quota is the smallest share of CPUs, not the smallest number
